DataVivid 0.1.2 adds a Windows installer.

## New: Windows installer

Download `DataVivid-0.1.2-windows-x64-setup.exe` and run it. That's all.

- It installs for your user only (no admin rights) to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\DataVivid`, and adds DataVivid to the Start menu (optionally to the desktop), to Settings > Apps, and to Explorer's *Open with* menu for CSV, Parquet, Excel, JSON, Arrow, Avro, ODS and SQLite files.
- **It replaces an older DataVivid.** An install made with the 0.1.0 or 0.1.1 zip (`install.ps1`) is upgraded in place and its old Settings > Apps entry is removed. Later versions of the setup replace this one in the same way. A running DataVivid is closed first.
- At the end you can open Settings > Default apps to make DataVivid the default app for your data files.
- Uninstall it from Settings > Apps > DataVivid. This also removes the file-type registration.

The setup is not code-signed yet. If SmartScreen warns, choose *More info > Run anyway*. It was tested automatically on Windows (install over a zip install, reinstall, uninstall).

The zip with `install.ps1` and the portable `datavivid.exe` are still available.

## Install

**Windows 10/11 (x64)**

- **Recommended:** `DataVivid-0.1.2-windows-x64-setup.exe` (see above).
- **Zip:** unpack `DataVivid-0.1.2-windows-x64.zip` and run `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1`.
- **Portable:** start `datavivid.exe` and use *Windows > Register DataVivid for data files*.

**Linux (x64, glibc 2.35+: Ubuntu 22.04+, Debian 12+, Fedora 36+)**

```bash
tar xzf DataVivid-0.1.2-linux-x64.tar.gz
cd DataVivid-0.1.2-linux-x64
./install.sh                 # or ./install.sh --no-default
```

There are no changes to the program itself since 0.1.1. See the [0.1.1 notes](https://github.com/FH-Prevail/DataVivid/releases/tag/v0.1.1) for the clipboard fix and the Linux build. macOS builds are still untested.
